scripts.dev:parity: npm run parity:build && LEITWERK_RUNTIME_LANE=dist concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names runtime,server,ext-ui,ui "npm:dev:runtime" "npm:dev:server:dist" "npm:dev:ext-ui" "npm:dev:ui"
scripts.build: TURBO_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 node scripts/run-quiet.mjs npx turbo run build --output-logs=errors-only && npm run --silent stage:licenses
scripts.build:ext-ui: TURBO_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 node scripts/run-quiet.mjs npx turbo run build:ext-ui --output-logs=errors-only
scripts.stage:licenses: test -f LICENSE || { echo 'Root LICENSE is missing' >&2; exit 1; }; for d in packages/* extensions/*; do test -f "$d/package.json" || continue; test -d "$d/dist" || { echo "Workspace dist directory is missing: $d/dist" >&2; exit 1; }; cmp -s LICENSE "$d/dist/LICENSE" || cp LICENSE "$d/dist/LICENSE"; done
scripts.parity:build: npm run --silent build && npm run --silent build:ext-ui
scripts.test:parity: npm run --silent parity:build && npm run --silent test:parity:built
scripts.test:full: TURBO_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm run --silent lint && npm run --silent parity:build && npm run --silent test:server-start && npm run --silent test:default-worker && npm run --silent check:boundaries && npm run --silent typecheck && npm run --silent test:parity:built && npm run --silent test:unit && npm run --silent test:integration && npm run --silent test:e2e && npm run --silent test:browser
